result.query: Trace the 3-hop contagion chain from Intel Corporation through disclosed Tungsten smelters in China to the modeled export-control disruption scenario.
result.answer: Intel Corporation discloses "China Molybdenum Tungsten Co., Ltd. (CHINA)" as a verified Tier-2/3 Tungsten smelter and refiner [CHUNK:CHK-SEC-SD-ISSUER-INTEL]. This facility, being a "tungsten refining facilit[y] located in China" [CHUNK:CHK-MOD-MOD-EVENT-CHINA-EXPORT-CTRL], would be affected by the "Hypothetical 90-day export licensing delay affecting tungsten and tin refining facilities located in China" [CHUNK:CHK-MOD-MOD-EVENT-CHINA-EXPORT-CTRL] as described in the modeled export-control disruption scenario.

stage_events.label: BigQuery VECTOR_SEARCH (chunks only — no graph hops)

payload.sql:
SELECT
  base.chunk_id,
  base.doc_name,
  base.doc_type,
  base.page_number,
  base.content,
  base.data_origin,
  base.source_license,
  base.source_url,
  distance
FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(
  (SELECT * FROM `acc05_enterprise_graphrag.source_chunks` WHERE pack_id = @pack_id AND ARRAY_LENGTH(embedding) > 0),
  'embedding',
  (SELECT @query_embedding AS embedding),
  top_k => 6,
  distance_type => 'COSINE'
)
ORDER BY distance ASC
